systems.system: Opération spéciale « Un enfant, un acte de naissance »
systems.country_label: Un enfant, un acte de naissance
systems.owner: Government with UNICEF support; operational set-up presented by ANATS; steering committee chaired by Goundoul Vikama
systems.tiers: first phase of six months in twelve provinces from 24 July 2026: community-recruited enrolment teams go household to household and a campaign runs in schools; target of at least one million children aged 4 months to 17 years
national; receives the data the campaign's teams collect

note: A campaign fielded for six months, so outreach and not an office: its teams capture children's data on smartphones for the national biometric register. Nothing is stated about how civil registration offices make their record. Also stated: a moratorium of 2 February 2026 suspends court fees for jugements supplétifs for children aged 4 months to 17 years until 2030.
